_about: Hand-checked company facts, keyed by company slug. Every company here must list its sources. Fields left out stay empty on the site.

alphabet.description: Alphabet is the holding company of Google. Most of its revenue comes from advertising on Google Search and YouTube. It also sells cloud computing through Google Cloud, subscriptions, apps and devices, and funds longer-term businesses such as Waymo.

story.title: Google is founded
story.text: Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporate Google in California.

story.title: Acquires YouTube
story.text: Google completes its purchase of YouTube.

story.title: Alphabet is created
story.text: Google reorganises under a new parent company, Alphabet Inc.
